usage.text:
kithsong.exe [--config-dir <folder>] [--] [folders or files to import...]

--config-dir <folder>
    Keeps settings.json and sync.db in <folder> instead of %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kithsong, so two copies of Kithsong can run, and sync, on one PC.

Folders and files given are imported.
